analysis.summary: The PR introduces several functional bugs related to the new Premium Connectivity feature, including missing data mapping, hardcoded strings, and incorrect legal/tax labels.

bugs.title: Missing incompatibleWithCart flag mapping
bugs.description: The function transformBundleProduct fails to map the 'incompatible' property from the API response (CompatibleProduct) to the ProductSearchProduct object. This flag is critical for the UI to display incompatibility warnings or prevent users from adding incompatible accessories/connectivity packages to their cart.

bugs.title: Hardcoded English string prevents localization
bugs.description: The price label for PREMIUM_CONNECTIVITY is hardcoded as 'Price for 12 Months(No Auto-Renewal)'. This bypasses the AEM translation system, causing incorrect (English) text to be displayed for all non-English markets.

bugs.title: Incorrect disclaimer reference for Premium Connectivity
bugs.description: The PremiumConnectivityTab incorrectly uses 'extendedWarrantyPriceDisclaimerReference' for its price superscript. Connectivity services should use their own specific legal disclaimer or a generic one; reusing the Extended Warranty disclaimer provides legally incorrect context to the user.

bugs.title: Incorrect tax label type for connectivity service
bugs.description: The component uses the 'common.label.tax.includesInsurancePremiumTax' (IPT) translation for the Premium Connectivity tab. Connectivity is a digital service usually subject to VAT, not Insurance Premium Tax. This displays misleading and legally incorrect tax information to the customer.

notBugs.reason: The duplicate 'notCashbuySecondarySectionDescription' in the GraphQL query is redundant but does not cause a functional failure.
The typo 'extendedWarrantyCompatibilityResultt' in the variable name in index.ts is purely cosmetic and does not affect runtime logic.
Disabling SourceMapDevToolPlugin for production builds is a standard optimization practice to reduce asset size and is not a bug.
